note: Record each line for both trainers as media/voice/<m|f>/<id>.mp3 and list it in media/voice/voice-manifest.json. IDs are stable.

lines.text: Paused. Say resume when you're ready.
Step back so I can see your whole body
Guard up! Hands back to your cheeks.
Great rhythm! You're right on the beat.
Keep moving. Small steps are perfect.
Listen for the kick drum and step with it.
Find a still point to look at. Breathe.
Lift a little higher, squeeze your glutes.
A little bigger range, still slow.
Sink a bit lower into the chair pose
Come up a little, knees no lower than the chair
Bend your front knee over your ankle
Lift one foot onto your ankle or calf, hold the chair if you need
Stand tall on the supporting leg
Make a straight line from head to knees
Forearms and knees down, body long
Welcome to Boxing! I'm Reta. 30 minutes, beginner friendly. Let's start with a 5 minute warm-up.
March and arm circles. March on the spot and circle your arms forwards, then backwards.
Next up: March and arm circles.
Step-touch and shoulder rolls. Step side to side and roll your shoulders back.
Next up: Step-touch and shoulder rolls.
Slow bob and weave. Small squat as you dip your head side to side under an imaginary rope.
Next up: Slow bob and weave.
Bend the knees, not the back
Easy jabs. Guard up: fists by your cheeks, elbows in, soft knees, one foot slightly forward. Gentle jabs with the lead hand.
Snap it out, snap it back
Torso twists in guard. Hold your guard and rotate gently from the waist.
Next up: Torso twists in guard.
Jab-cross ×8. Guard up: fists by your cheeks, elbows in, soft knees, one foot slightly forward. Jab (front hand), cross (back hand). 8 then reset.
Rotate the back hip on the cross
Jab-cross ×8, then hooks. Eight jab-crosses, then hooks: elbow up at shoulder height, swing round, pivot.
Speed jabs (low impact). Quick light jabs, small bounce or just soft knees.
Hooks left and right. Left hook, right hook. Elbows up, pivot the feet.
Next up: Hooks left and right.
Jab-cross-hook. Jab, cross, lead hook. Reset to guard.
Uppercuts. Dip slightly, drive up from the legs, palm facing you. Drive up from your hips, fist rising to chin height.
Jab-cross-slip. Jab, cross, then slip: small dip of the head to one side.
Body jabs with a squat. Bend the knees and jab to body height, stand back up.
Next up: Body jabs with a squat.
Sit back like the chair is there
Uppercut-hook combo. Rear uppercut, lead hook, repeat. Drive up from your hips, fist rising to chin height.
Speed punches. Fast straight punches, light hands, soft knees.
Bob and weave + cross. Weave under the rope, come up with a cross.
Next up: Bob and weave + cross.
Combo ladder. Build it up: 1-2, then 1-2-3, then 1-2-3-2.
Power round: jab-cross ×8 then hooks. Eight strong jab-crosses, then hooks until the bell.
Next up: Power round: jab-cross ×8 then hooks.
Finisher: speed punches. Everything you have left, fast light punches.
Slow march and breathe. Slow march, big breath in, long breath out.
Next up: Slow march and breathe.
Chest and shoulder stretch. Hands behind you, gently open the chest.
Next up: Chest and shoulder stretch.
Triceps stretch. One hand down your back, gently press the elbow. Swap at 30 seconds.
Thigh stretch (hold the chair). Hold a chair, bring one heel to your bum. Swap at 30 seconds.
Next up: Thigh stretch (hold the chair).
Calf stretch and breathe. Hands on the wall, one leg back, heel down. Swap at 30 seconds.
Next up: Calf stretch and breathe.
Welcome to Dance! I'm Reta. 30 minutes, beginner friendly. Let's start with a 5 minute warm-up.
Step-touch. Step right, tap left; step left, tap right.
Step-touch with arm swings. Add a gentle arm swing across the body.
Next up: Step-touch with arm swings.
Layer it up: Add arms: swing on every step
Slow grapevine. Step side, cross behind, step side, tap. Then back.
Hip rolls and shoulder pops. Feet wide, roll the hips, pop the shoulders on the beat.
Next up: Hip rolls and shoulder pops.
Knee lift and clap. Lift a knee and clap under it, alternate.
Next up: Knee lift and clap.
Box step. Right foot forward, left forward, right back, left back.
Box step + arms. Layer the arms: reach up on 1-2, down on 3-4.
Layer it up: Add arms: up on 1-2, down on 3-4
Grapevine + clap. Grapevine right with a clap on 4, left with a clap on 8.
Layer it up: 5-7 grapevine left, clap on 8
Routine A: box step + grapevine. Put them together: one 8 of box steps, one 8 of grapevines.
Next up: Routine A: box step + grapevine.
Layer it up: 8 grapevine right and left
Hamstring curls + arms. Step out and curl the heel behind, pull the arms in.
Layer it up: Add a row with the arms
Double step-touch. Two step-touches right, two left.
Routine A with arms. Routine A with all the arm layers.
Next up: Routine A with arms.
Layer it up: Grapevine, clap on 4 and 8
Side step + body roll. Step out wide and roll through the body (small is fine).
Next up: Side step + body roll.
Layer it up: 5-6 step left, 7-8 roll
Kick-ball-change (low). Small kick forward, step back on the ball of the foot, change. No jumping.
Layer it up: Other side on 3-4
Routine B layered. Side step + body roll, then kick-ball-change.
Low-impact pony step. Small side-to-side shuffle, no jumping.
Mambo step. Step forward, rock back, step together.
Routine B with arms. Routine B with arms reaching on every step.
Next up: Routine B with arms.
Layer it up: Kick-ball-change, arms punch down
Freestyle groove. Your move! Any step from today, stay on the beat.
Layer it up: Stay on the beat
Full routine A + B. Everything: routine A, then routine B, on repeat.
Next up: Full routine A + B.
Layer it up: Routine B: roll + kick-ball-change
Slow sway. Slow side-to-side sway, let the arms float.
Side stretch. One arm up and over. Swap at 30 seconds.
Hamstring stretch. One heel forward, toes up, hinge from the hips.
Thigh stretch (hold the chair). Heel to bum, holding a chair. Swap at 30 seconds.
Next up: Thigh stretch (hold the chair).
Breathe and shake out. Big breaths, shake out the hands and legs.
Next up: Breathe and shake out.
Welcome to Latin Dance Cardio! I'm Reta. 30 minutes, beginner friendly. Let's start with a 5 minute warm-up.
Merengue march. March on the spot, let the hips move naturally.
Merengue + arms. Add arm rolls and elbow pumps.
Layer it up: Add arm rolls on 5-8
Slow salsa basic. Forward on 1, back to centre on 2-3; back on 5, centre on 6-7.
Hip sways. Feet wide, sway the hips side to side.
Slow cumbia step. Step back on a diagonal, return; other side.
Merengue. Marching merengue, add side steps.
Layer it up: Side steps right 5-8
Salsa basic. Forward-back salsa basic, add shoulders.
Salsa side + arms. Side salsa: right on 1, left on 5, arms open.
Layer it up: 5 side left, 6-7 centre
Cumbia. Cumbia step with a small turn of the shoulders.
Layer it up: Add shoulder turn
Reggaeton step (low impact). Bounce the knees, step side, tap.
Layer it up: Step left, tap
Layer it up: Add arm pumps
Cha-cha side. Rock step, then cha-cha-cha to the side.
Layer it up: 6-7 rock, 8&1 cha-cha-cha left
Combo: merengue + salsa. One 8 merengue, one 8 salsa basic.
Layer it up: Repeat and smile
Layer it up: 5 back, 6 rock, 7 together
Samba-style bounce (low). Small bounce through the knees, step-ball-change. No jumping.
Cumbia combo. Cumbia + side steps with arms.
Layer it up: 8 side steps, arms open
Slow salsa turn. Easy walk-around turn in 4 steps, or just sway.
Merengue party. Merengue with big arms and hip sways.
Layer it up: Add arm rolls
Layer it up: Add hip sways
Reggaeton combo. Step-taps with shoulder pops.
Layer it up: Step-tap left, pop
Freestyle fiesta. Any Latin step you like, stay with the beat.
Full combo. Merengue, salsa, cumbia: one 8 each.
Slow sway. Slow hip sway, long breaths.
Arm and shoulder stretch. Arm across the chest, then swap.
Next up: Arm and shoulder stretch.
Side stretch. Reach up and over, swap at 30 seconds.
Hamstring stretch. Heel forward, hinge from the hips.
Breathe. Hands on your heart, slow breaths.
Welcome to Yoga! I'm Reta. 30 minutes, beginner friendly. Let's start with a 5 minute warm-up.
Breathing with arms. Stand tall. Breathe in for 4 as the arms rise, out for 6 as they lower.
Neck and shoulder rolls. Gentle half-circles with the head, then roll the shoulders.
Next up: Neck and shoulder rolls.
Cat-cow (seated or all fours). Breathe in, lift the chest; breathe out, round the back.
Next up: Cat-cow (seated or all fours).
Standing side bend. Arms up, lean gently to one side, then the other.
Mountain pose. Stand tall, feet hip-width, arms by your sides. Breathe.
Chair pose. Feet together or hip-width, sit back as if into a chair, arms up.
Breathe out, sit a little lower
Warrior II (right). Feet wide, right toes out, bend the right knee over the ankle, arms out at shoulder height.
Warrior II (left). Same on the left side.
Tree pose (right, hold the chair). Stand on the left leg, right foot on your ankle or calf (never the knee). Hold a chair if you like.
Next up: Tree pose (right, hold the chair).
Tree pose (left). Stand on the right leg, left foot on the ankle or calf.
Find a spot to focus on
Chair pose flow. Inhale stand, exhale sit into chair pose. Hold the last one.
Downward dog (knees bent). From all fours, tuck the toes and lift the hips. Keep the knees bent and heels up.
Cat-cow flow. On all fours: inhale, lift the chest; exhale, round the back.
Triangle (right, short). Legs wide, reach forward over the right leg, hand to the shin or a chair, other arm up.
Mountain flow with arms. Stand tall. Inhale, arms overhead; exhale, hands to heart.
Next up: Mountain flow with arms.
Chair pose hold. One more chair pose. Hold and breathe.
Sink a little lower if you can
Warrior II flow (both sides). Warrior II right, straighten, warrior II left, with the breath.
Next up: Warrior II flow (both sides).
Tree pose (right) again. Try lifting the arms if you feel steady.
Seated forward fold. Sit, legs forward, hinge gently towards your toes.
Gentle cat-cow. On all fours, slow cat-cow with long breaths.
Supine twist. On your back, knees bent, let them drop to one side, then the other. Keep knees bent together and let them drop slowly side to side.
Child's pose. Knees wide, sit back to your heels, arms forward.
Relaxation. Lie or sit comfortably. Close your eyes. Breathe.
Welcome to Pilates! I'm Reta. 30 minutes, beginner friendly. Let's start with a 5 minute warm-up.
Breathing and pelvic tilts. Lie on your back, knees bent. Gently tilt the pelvis with the breath. Keep your hips on the floor. Hips stay on the floor, just flatten and arch your lower back.
Next up: Breathing and pelvic tilts.
Small bridges. Peel the hips up a little, then down. Slow.
The hundred (knees bent, gentle). On your back, feet on the floor, pump the arms low. Breathe in for 5 pumps, out for 5. Head down is fine.
Next up: The hundred (knees bent, gentle).
Spine stretch forward. Sit tall, legs apart, reach forward as you breathe out, roll up as you breathe in.
Single leg stretch (beginner). On your back, hug one knee in while the other leg reaches long. Swap slowly. Head down is fine.
Glute bridge. Feet flat, squeeze and lift the hips, lower slowly.
Lower one bone at a time
Side-lying leg lift (right). Lie on your left side, lift the top leg slowly, lower with control.
Clams (right). Lie on your side, knees bent, feet together, open the top knee. Keep your feet together, just open the top knee.
Clams (left). Other side. Keep your feet together, just open the top knee.
Bird dog. On all fours, reach one arm forward and the opposite leg back, return, swap.
Knee plank. Forearms down, knees down, straight line from head to knees.
Bridge with a hold. Lift, hold for 2, lower slowly.
Next up: Bridge with a hold.
Leg lift (right) round 2. Smaller and slower than before.
Bird dog round 2. Pause for a breath at full reach.
Knee plank round 2. Head to knees in one line.
Clams (right) round 2. Pause at the top. Keep your feet together, just open the top knee.
Clams (left) round 2. Other side. Keep your feet together, just open the top knee.
Bridge pulses. Lift, then small pulses at the top, lower slowly.
Spine stretch forward. Sit tall, legs apart, reach forward slowly and breathe.
Lying spine twist. On your back, knees to one side, then the other.
Hamstring stretch. On your back, one leg up, hold behind the thigh.
Figure-4 stretch. Ankle on the opposite knee, gently draw in. Swap at 30 seconds.
Breathe. Long slow breaths. Well done.
